card.name: Occupation noun in encyclopedia openers
card.fires_on: The noun naming what someone or something is, right after a nationality or type word in a first-line definition, especially "painter" in artist biographies.

modes.label: Painter after nationality
modes.description: The word painter in a biography opener, after a nationality or genre such as French or landscape.

modes.label: Software or thing category noun
modes.description: A category noun such as library, template or tool in a definition of a software item.
modes.example: The Tree Container Library (TCL) is a class<< template>> library that you can use to store data

modes.label: Species or profession endings
modes.description: The word of after species, or the ending of a profession word like botanist, in a descriptive opener.
